title: Surrender of a permit
rule: A permit holder may apply to surrender their permit; the Director or forest manager decides whether to accept it, and may attach conditions.
points: Application is on the prescribed form to the Director or forest manager (s.54(1)).
Acceptance may be made subject to conditions under s.52, chosen to avoid adverse effects on the forest reserve where the permitted activity took place (s.54(3)).
A surrender does not limit any civil or criminal liability the holder already incurred before the surrender (s.54(5)(a)).
